title: Album Cover with Portrait and Typographic Elements
coreRelationships: The man's portrait dominates the right side, creating a strong focal point.
Typographic elements are strategically placed on the left and bottom to balance the composition.
The monochromatic color scheme unifies the image and emphasizes the vintage aesthetic.
The outlined text for the main name contrasts with the solid text for the subtitle, creating visual hierarchy.
The small star graphics act as dividers and decorative elements, framing the 'Artistry in Soul' text.
